title: Enable Stripe Smart Retries and record attempts
goal: After merge, every failed card charge is retried by Stripe on its Smart Retries schedule, and each attempt (initial and retries) is recorded in a payment_attempts table with its outcome, so recovery rate can be measured and shown to support. Serves the Failed-payment recovery rate and Involuntary churn metrics. Missed in production if payment_attempts stays empty while Stripe reports failures.
context: Stripe webhooks arrive at app/controllers/webhooks/stripe_controller.rb:14-40, which verifies the signature and dispatches by event type to Billing::StripeWebhookHandler (app/services/billing/stripe_webhook_handler.rb:8-61). Only invoice.paid and customer.subscription.deleted are handled today (lines 20-31); invoice.payment_failed falls through to the no-op default at line 58. Smart Retries is a Stripe account setting, not an API call; the Stripe Billing dashboard toggle is out of code scope and is listed as an external step. Existing failure path: Billing::FailureNotifier (app/services/billing/failure_notifier.rb:5) sends one email and sets accounts.payment_failed_at.

acceptance_criteria.given: a Stripe invoice.payment_failed webhook for a known customer
acceptance_criteria.then: a payment_attempts row is created with stripe_event_id, stripe_invoice_id, attempt_number (from invoice.attempt_count), outcome 'failed', failure_code, and occurred_at

acceptance_criteria.given: a Stripe invoice.paid webhook for an invoice that has prior failed attempts
acceptance_criteria.then: a payment_attempts row with outcome 'succeeded' is created and accounts.payment_failed_at is cleared

acceptance_criteria.given: the same Stripe event delivered twice (same stripe_event_id)
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly one payment_attempts row exists and the second delivery returns 200

acceptance_criteria.given: an invoice.payment_failed webhook whose invoice has next_payment_attempt null (Stripe gave up)
acceptance_criteria.then: the row is created with final_attempt true and a BillingEvents::RetriesExhausted event is published

acceptance_criteria.given: a webhook for a customer id not in our database
acceptance_criteria.then: no row is created, the event is logged at warn with the customer id, and the response is 200

acceptance_criteria.when: it runs on a copy of production data
acceptance_criteria.then: it is additive only: creates payment_attempts and its indexes, touches no existing table
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Reviewed by reading the migration; enforced by allowed_paths and the must_not constraint.

acceptance_criteria.then: Billing::FailureNotifier is still invoked exactly once per failed attempt (behaviour unchanged until spec_dunning-emails replaces it)

acceptance_criteria.given: any webhook handled by this change
acceptance_criteria.then: the exception is reported to the error tracker and the response is 500 so Stripe retries delivery

interfaces.name: payment_attempts
interfaces.definition: payment_attempts(id bigint pk, account_id bigint fk accounts not null, stripe_invoice_id string not null, stripe_event_id string not null unique, attempt_number int not null, outcome enum('failed','succeeded') not null, failure_code string null, final_attempt boolean not null default false, occurred_at timestamptz not null, created_at). Indexes: unique(stripe_event_id); (account_id, occurred_at desc).

interfaces.name: BillingEvents::RetriesExhausted
interfaces.definition: ActiveSupport::Notifications event 'billing.retries_exhausted' with payload {account_id:, stripe_invoice_id:, last_attempt_at:}. Published once per invoice when Stripe reports no further retry.

interfaces.name: PaymentAttempt model
interfaces.definition: class PaymentAttempt < ApplicationRecord; scope :open_failures -> accounts whose latest attempt is failed and not final; def self.record_from_stripe_event!(event) -> PaymentAttempt (idempotent on stripe_event_id)

interfaces.name: service_manifest.json
interfaces.definition: Per the platform contract: env gains {name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, secret: true} if absent; migrations.additive_only stays true. No runtime, health, or resource change.

forbidden_changes: Any ALTER on the payments or accounts tables
Editing existing specs under spec/ other than adding new examples to stripe_webhook_handler_spec.rb

non_functional.performance: Webhook handling stays under 200ms p95; the new insert is one row with two indexes.
non_functional.security: No card data is read from the event; only ids, codes, and timestamps are stored.
non_functional.observability: Log line per attempt at info: account_id, attempt_number, outcome, failure_code.
non_functional.backwards_compatibility: Existing invoice.paid behaviour unchanged except the new row and clearing payment_failed_at.

new_tests.description: payment_failed creates a failed attempt and still notifies
invoice.paid after failures records success and clears payment_failed_at
null next_payment_attempt marks final and publishes RetriesExhausted
unknown customer logs and returns without a row
handler exceptions are reported and surface as 500
HTTP-level checks that post signed fixture events to a running instance (used by the e2e entries below)

e2e.description: Posts a signed invoice.payment_failed fixture to the preview's /webhooks/stripe, expects 200; posts it again, expects 200 and the same attempt (idempotency surfaced through the admin JSON endpoint that spec_at-risk-admin adds, or the response header X-Payment-Attempt-Id until then).

e2e.command: E2E_BASE_URL=$BASE_URL bundle exec rspec spec/e2e/stripe_webhook_preview_spec.rb -e 'unknown customer'
e2e.description: Posts a fixture for a customer id not in the preview database; expects 200 and no attempt id in the response.

e2e.command: E2E_BASE_URL=$BASE_URL bundle exec rspec spec/e2e/stripe_webhook_preview_spec.rb -e 'handler failure'
e2e.description: Posts a fixture whose invoice object is malformed so the handler raises; expects 500 so Stripe would retry.
Same checks against a locally booted server (bin/with-server starts Rails on :3000 and exports E2E_BASE_URL); lets the implementer iterate before the preview deploy finishes.

external: Stripe dashboard: enable Smart Retries (owner action, before launch)

migration_steps: Enable Smart Retries in Stripe dashboard
rollout.rollback: Disable Smart Retries toggle; code path is inert without payment_failed events; table can remain.

open_questions.question: Keep attempts for deleted accounts (FK on delete)?
open_questions.default_if_unanswered: ON DELETE CASCADE, matching the payments table convention at db/schema.rb:212
